name: dbg5
eval: (async()=>{const R=window.__hq.renderer;let L=null;R.scene.traverse(o=>{if(o.isLOD&&Math.abs(o.position.z-2125)<5&&Math.abs(o.position.x)<5)L=o;});const log=[];const orig=L.update.bind(L);L.update=(c)=>{orig(c);if(log.length<6){const cp=c.getWorldPosition(new c.position.constructor());log.push(c.type+' zoom='+c.zoom+' cam='+cp.x.toFixed(0)+','+cp.y.toFixed(0)+','+cp.z.toFixed(0)+' lv='+L.levels.map(l=>l.object.visible).join('/')+' cur='+L.getCurrentLevel());}};await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800));return log.join(' || ')})()
